datasets.displayName: Efficiency by Provider Practice (PBI visual logic)
queryLines:
WITH tri AS (
  SELECT team_rolled_up AS team, radiologist AS rad, parent_exam AS proc,
    SUM(CASE WHEN exam_date BETWEEN :period.min AND :period.max THEN x_f END) x_f,
    SUM(CASE WHEN exam_date BETWEEN :period.min AND :period.max THEN t_f END) t_f,
    SUM(CASE WHEN exam_date BETWEEN :period.min AND :period.max THEN w_f END) w_f,
    SUM(CASE WHEN exam_date BETWEEN :period.min AND :period.max THEN c_f END) c_f,
    SUM(CASE WHEN exam_date BETWEEN :period.min AND :period.max THEN x_r END) x_r,
    SUM(CASE WHEN exam_date BETWEEN :period.min AND :period.max THEN t_r END) t_r,
    SUM(CASE WHEN exam_date BETWEEN :period.min AND :period.max THEN w_r END) w_r,
    SUM(CASE WHEN exam_date BETWEEN :period.min AND :period.max THEN c_r END) c_r,
    SUM(CASE WHEN exam_date BETWEEN :period.min AND :period.max THEN x_d END) x_d,
    SUM(CASE WHEN exam_date BETWEEN :period.min AND :period.max THEN t_d END) t_d,
    SUM(CASE WHEN exam_date BETWEEN :period.min AND :period.max THEN w_d END) w_d,
    SUM(CASE WHEN exam_date BETWEEN :period.min AND :period.max THEN c_d END) c_d,
    SUM(CASE WHEN exam_date BETWEEN :period.min AND :period.max THEN x_c END) x_c,
    SUM(CASE WHEN exam_date BETWEEN :period.min AND :period.max THEN t_c END) t_c,
    SUM(CASE WHEN exam_date BETWEEN :period.min AND :period.max THEN w_c END) w_c,
    SUM(CASE WHEN exam_date BETWEEN :period.min AND :period.max THEN c_c END) c_c,
    SUM(CASE WHEN exam_date BETWEEN :period.min AND :period.max THEN x_dc END) x_dc,
    SUM(CASE WHEN exam_date BETWEEN :period.min AND :period.max THEN t_dc END) t_dc,
    SUM(CASE WHEN exam_date BETWEEN :period.min AND :period.max THEN w_dc END) w_dc,
    SUM(CASE WHEN exam_date BETWEEN :period.min AND :period.max THEN c_dc END) c_dc,
    SUM(bx_all) bx_all, SUM(bx_crct) bx_crct, SUM(bx_usbd) bx_usbd, SUM(bx_dc) bx_dc,
    MAX(be_proc) be_proc, MAX(be_usbd) be_usbd
  FROM edw_test.enterprise_analytics.mosaic_eff_provider_leaf_modes_mv
  WHERE bx_all IS NOT NULL OR exam_date BETWEEN :period.min AND :period.max
  GROUP BY ALL
),
leaf AS (
  SELECT 'Full Mosaic' AS mode, team, rad, proc, x_f x, t_f t, w_f w, c_f c, bx_all bx, be_proc be FROM tri WHERE x_f IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Reporting Only', team, rad, proc, x_r, t_r, w_r, c_r, bx_all, be_proc FROM tri WHERE x_r IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Drafting Only', team, rad, proc, x_d, t_d, w_d, c_d, bx_crct, be_proc FROM tri WHERE x_d IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Capture Only', team, rad, proc, x_c, t_c, w_c, c_c, bx_usbd, be_usbd FROM tri WHERE x_c IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Drafting + Capture', team, rad, proc, x_dc, t_dc, w_dc, c_dc, bx_dc, be_proc FROM tri WHERE x_dc IS NOT NULL
),
rad_full AS (
  SELECT mode, team, rad, SUM(x) >= 1 AND SUM(t) > 0 AND SUM(c) / SUM(t) > 0 AND SUM(w) IS NOT NULL AS rad_q
  FROM leaf GROUP BY ALL
),
leaf_s AS (
  SELECT l.*, r.rad_q AND l.x > 0 AND COALESCE(l.bx, 0) > 0 AND l.t > 0 AND l.c / l.t > 0 AND l.w IS NOT NULL AS s
  FROM leaf l JOIN rad_full r ON r.mode = l.mode AND r.team <=> l.team AND r.rad <=> l.rad
),
tp AS (SELECT DISTINCT mode, team, proc FROM leaf_s WHERE s),
leaf_c AS (
  SELECT l.*, CASE WHEN l.s THEN 'S' WHEN tp.proc IS NOT NULL THEN 'R' ELSE 'D' END AS cls
  FROM leaf_s l LEFT JOIN tp ON tp.mode = l.mode AND tp.team <=> l.team AND tp.proc <=> l.proc
),
rad_sr AS (
  SELECT mode, team, rad, SUM(x) x, SUM(t) t, SUM(w) w, SUM(c) c
  FROM leaf_c WHERE cls <> 'D' GROUP BY ALL HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN cls = 'S' THEN 1 END) = 1
),
practice_rows AS (
  SELECT mode, team AS `Provider Practice`, 1 AS sort_key, COUNT(*) AS `Radiologists`, SUM(x) AS `Mosaic Exams`,
    SUM(c) / SUM(t) AS `Baseline Efficiency`, 60 * SUM(w) / SUM(t) AS `Mosaic Efficiency`
  FROM rad_sr WHERE x >= 1 AND t > 0 AND c / t > 0 AND w IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ALL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT mode, 'Total', 0, COUNT(*), SUM(x), SUM(c) / SUM(t), 60 * SUM(w) / SUM(t)
  FROM (SELECT mode, rad, SUM(x) x, SUM(t) t, SUM(w) w, SUM(c) c FROM rad_sr GROUP BY ALL)
  WHERE x >= 1 AND t > 0 AND c / t > 0 AND w IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ALL
),
radiologist_rows AS (
  SELECT mode, team AS `Provider Practice`, rad AS `Radiologist`, SUM(x) AS `Mosaic Exams`,
    SUM(c) / SUM(t) AS `Baseline Efficiency`, 60 * SUM(w) / SUM(t) AS `Mosaic Efficiency`
  FROM leaf_c WHERE cls = 'S' GROUP BY ALL
),
parent_exam_rows AS (
  SELECT mode, team AS `Provider Practice`, rad AS `Radiologist`, proc AS `Parent Exam`, x AS `Mosaic Exams`,
    be AS `Baseline Efficiency`, 60 * w / t AS `Mosaic Efficiency`
  FROM leaf_c WHERE cls = 'S'
)
SELECT mode AS `Mode`, * EXCEPT (mode), try_divide(`Mosaic Efficiency` - `Baseline Efficiency`, `Baseline Efficiency`) AS `Pct Change Vs Baseline`,
  :period.min AS `Window Start`, :period.max AS `Window End`
FROM practice_rows

datasets.name: ds_mp_practice
datasets.displayName: Efficiency by Managing Practice (PBI visual logic)
queryLines:
WITH site_sums AS (
  SELECT managing_practice AS pr, site,
    SUM(CASE WHEN exam_date BETWEEN :period.min AND :period.max THEN x_f END) x_f,
    SUM(CASE WHEN exam_date BETWEEN :period.min AND :period.max THEN t_f END) t_f,
    SUM(CASE WHEN exam_date BETWEEN :period.min AND :period.max THEN w_f END) w_f,
    SUM(CASE WHEN exam_date BETWEEN :period.min AND :period.max THEN c_f END) c_f,
    SUM(CASE WHEN exam_date BETWEEN :period.min AND :period.max THEN xn_f END) mx_f,
    SUM(xn_f) ste_f,
    SUM(CASE WHEN exam_date BETWEEN :period.min AND :period.max THEN x_r END) x_r,
    SUM(CASE WHEN exam_date BETWEEN :period.min AND :period.max THEN t_r END) t_r,
    SUM(CASE WHEN exam_date BETWEEN :period.min AND :period.max THEN w_r END) w_r,
    SUM(CASE WHEN exam_date BETWEEN :period.min AND :period.max THEN c_r END) c_r,
    SUM(CASE WHEN exam_date BETWEEN :period.min AND :period.max THEN xn_r END) mx_r,
    SUM(xn_r) ste_r,
    SUM(CASE WHEN exam_date BETWEEN :period.min AND :period.max THEN x_d END) x_d,
    SUM(CASE WHEN exam_date BETWEEN :period.min AND :period.max THEN t_d END) t_d,
    SUM(CASE WHEN exam_date BETWEEN :period.min AND :period.max THEN w_d END) w_d,
    SUM(CASE WHEN exam_date BETWEEN :period.min AND :period.max THEN c_d END) c_d,
    SUM(CASE WHEN exam_date BETWEEN :period.min AND :period.max THEN xn_d END) mx_d,
    SUM(xn_d) ste_d,
    SUM(CASE WHEN exam_date BETWEEN :period.min AND :period.max THEN x_c END) x_c,
    SUM(CASE WHEN exam_date BETWEEN :period.min AND :period.max THEN t_c END) t_c,
    SUM(CASE WHEN exam_date BETWEEN :period.min AND :period.max THEN w_c END) w_c,
    SUM(CASE WHEN exam_date BETWEEN :period.min AND :period.max THEN c_c END) c_c,
    SUM(CASE WHEN exam_date BETWEEN :period.min AND :period.max THEN xn_c END) mx_c,
    SUM(xn_c) ste_c,
    SUM(CASE WHEN exam_date BETWEEN :period.min AND :period.max THEN x_dc END) x_dc,
    SUM(CASE WHEN exam_date BETWEEN :period.min AND :period.max THEN t_dc END) t_dc,
    SUM(CASE WHEN exam_date BETWEEN :period.min AND :period.max THEN w_dc END) w_dc,
    SUM(CASE WHEN exam_date BETWEEN :period.min AND :period.max THEN c_dc END) c_dc,
    SUM(CASE WHEN exam_date BETWEEN :period.min AND :period.max THEN xn_dc END) mx_dc,
    SUM(xn_dc) ste_dc,
    SUM(bx_all) bx_all, SUM(bx_crct) bx_crct, SUM(bx_usbd) bx_usbd, SUM(bx_dc) bx_dc
  FROM edw_test.enterprise_analytics.mosaic_eff_managing_site_modes_mv
  GROUP BY ALL
),
site AS (
  SELECT 'Full Mosaic' AS mode, pr, site, x_f x, t_f t, w_f w, c_f c, mx_f mx, ste_f ste, bx_all bx FROM site_sums
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Reporting Only', pr, site, x_r, t_r, w_r, c_r, mx_r, ste_r, bx_all FROM site_sums
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Drafting Only', pr, site, x_d, t_d, w_d, c_d, mx_d, ste_d, bx_crct FROM site_sums
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Capture Only', pr, site, x_c, t_c, w_c, c_c, mx_c, ste_c, bx_usbd FROM site_sums
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Drafting + Capture', pr, site, x_dc, t_dc, w_dc, c_dc, mx_dc, ste_dc, bx_dc FROM site_sums
),
surv AS (
  SELECT s.* FROM site s
  JOIN (SELECT mode, pr, SUM(x) px FROM site GROUP BY ALL) p ON p.mode = s.mode AND p.pr <=> s.pr
  WHERE s.x > 0 AND s.t > 0 AND s.c IS NOT NULL AND s.w IS NOT NULL AND p.px >= 1
    AND try_divide(s.c, s.t) <> 0 AND try_divide(s.w, s.t) <> 0
),
practice_rows AS (
  SELECT mode, 'Total' AS `Managing Practice`, 0 AS sort_key, COUNT(*) AS `Sites`,
    SUM(ste) ste, SUM(bx) bx, SUM(mx) mx, SUM(c) / SUM(t) b, 60 * SUM(w) / SUM(t) m
  FROM surv GROUP BY ALL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT mode, pr, 1, COUNT(*), SUM(ste), SUM(bx), SUM(mx), SUM(c) / SUM(t), 60 * SUM(w) / SUM(t)
  FROM surv GROUP BY ALL
),
site_rows AS (
  SELECT mode, pr AS `Managing Practice`, site AS `Site`, ste, bx, mx, c / t b, 60 * w / t m
  FROM surv
)
SELECT mode AS `Mode`, * EXCEPT (mode, ste, bx, mx, b, m),
  CASE WHEN ste > 0 THEN ste END AS `Site Total Mosaic Exams`,
  CASE WHEN bx > 0 THEN bx END AS `Baseline Exams`,
  CASE WHEN mx > 0 THEN mx END AS `Mosaic Exams`,
  b AS `Baseline Efficiency`, m AS `Mosaic Efficiency`,
  try_divide(m - b, b) AS `Pct Change Vs Baseline`,
  1 - try_divide(b, m) AS `Implied Read Time Savings Pct`,
  :period.min AS `Window Start`, :period.max AS `Window End`
FROM practice_rows

  FROM edw_test.enterprise_analytics.mosaic_eff_vs_avg_daily_mv
  GROUP BY ALL
),
lw AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE WHEN xd IS NOT NULL OR xc IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(xd, 0) + COALESCE(xc, 0) END xdc,
    CASE WHEN td IS NOT NULL OR tc IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(td, 0) + COALESCE(tc, 0) END tdc,
    CASE WHEN wd IS NOT NULL OR wc IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(wd, 0) + COALESCE(wc, 0) END wdc,
    CASE WHEN xa IS NOT NULL OR xr IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(xa, 0) + COALESCE(xr, 0) END xf,
    CASE WHEN ta IS NOT NULL OR tr IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(ta, 0) + COALESCE(tr, 0) END tf,
    CASE WHEN wa IS NOT NULL OR wr IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(wa, 0) + COALESCE(wr, 0) END wf,
    CASE WHEN all_d IS NOT NULL OR all_c IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(all_d, 0) + COALESCE(all_c, 0) END all_dc,
    CASE WHEN all_a IS NOT NULL OR all_r IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(all_a, 0) + COALESCE(all_r, 0) END all_f
  FROM lf WHERE in_window = 1
),
leaf AS (
  SELECT 'Drafting Only' AS mode, team, rad, proc, xd q, xd p, ta et, wa ew, all_d ax, xd bx, td bt, wd bw FROM lw
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Reporting Only', team, rad, proc, xr, xr, tr, wr, all_r, xr, tr, wr FROM lw
  UNION ALL

  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Drafting + Capture', team, rad, proc, xdc, xdc, tf, wf, all_dc, xdc, tdc, wdc FROM lw
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Full Mosaic', team, rad, proc, xf, xf, tf, wf, all_f, xf, tf, wf FROM lw
),
rad_q AS (

    r.ew / (r.et / 60) / b.overall_avg AS `Vs RP Avg Overall`, r.ew / (r.et / 60) / b.shown_avg AS `Vs RP Avg`
  FROM vf_rad r JOIN bench b ON b.mode = r.mode

    CASE WHEN xa IS NOT NULL OR xr IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(xa, 0) + COALESCE(xr, 0) END xf,
    CASE WHEN ta IS NOT NULL OR tr IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(ta, 0) + COALESCE(tr, 0) END tf,
    CASE WHEN wa IS NOT NULL OR wr IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(wa, 0) + COALESCE(wr, 0) END wf,
    CASE WHEN all_d IS NOT NULL OR all_c IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(all_d, 0) + COALESCE(all_c, 0) END all_dc,
    CASE WHEN all_a IS NOT NULL OR all_r IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(all_a, 0) + COALESCE(all_r, 0) END all_f
  FROM lf WHERE in_window = 1
),
leaf AS (
  SELECT 'Drafting Only' AS mode, team, rad, proc, xd q, xd p, ta et, wa ew, all_d ax, xd bx, td bt, wd bw FROM lw
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Reporting Only', team, rad, proc, xr, xr, tr, wr, all_r, xr, tr, wr FROM lw
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Capture Only', team, rad, proc, xc, xf, tc, wc, all_f, xc, tc, wc FROM lw
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Drafting + Capture', team, rad, proc, xdc, xdc, tf, wf, all_dc, xdc, tdc, wdc FROM lw
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Full Mosaic', team, rad, proc, xf, xf, tf, wf, all_f, xf, tf, wf FROM lw
),
rad_q AS (
  SELECT mode, team, rad, COALESCE(SUM(q), 0) >= :min_exams AS qualifies FROM leaf GROUP BY ALL
),
vf AS (
  SELECT l.* FROM leaf l JOIN rad_q r ON r.mode = l.mode AND r.team <=> l.team AND r.rad <=> l.rad

card_rad AS (

cards AS (
  SELECT mode,

    SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(bx, 0) >= :min_exams AND bt > 0 THEN bw END)

  FROM card_rad GROUP BY ALL
),
tp AS (SELECT DISTINCT mode, team, proc FROM vf),
shown_rad AS (
  SELECT l.mode, l.rad, SUM(l.bx) bx, SUM(l.bt) bt, SUM(l.bw) bw

bench AS (

  FROM cards c LEFT JOIN (

    FROM shown_rad GROUP BY ALL
  ) s ON s.mode = c.mode

dim AS (

datasets.name: ds_va_ts
datasets.displayName: Efficiency vs Average time series (PBI visual logic)
queryLines:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', exam_date) AS month_start, team_rolled_up, radiologist,
    x_d, t_d, w_d, x_r, t_r, w_r, x_a, t_a, w_a
  FROM edw_test.enterprise_analytics.mosaic_eff_vs_avg_daily_mv
),
monthly AS (
  SELECT month_start, team_rolled_up, radiologist,
    SUM(x_d) AS x_d, SUM(t_d) AS t_d, SUM(w_d) AS w_d,
    SUM(x_r) AS x_r, SUM(t_r) AS t_r, SUM(w_r) AS w_r,
    SUM(x_a) AS x_a, SUM(t_a) AS t_a, SUM(w_a) AS w_a,
    COUNT(x_d) AS n_d, COUNT(x_a) + COUNT(x_r) AS n_f
  FROM base
  GROUP BY ALL
),
pooled AS (
  SELECT *,
    COALESCE(x_a, 0) + COALESCE(x_r, 0) AS x_f_raw,
    CASE WHEN x_a IS NOT NULL OR x_r IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(t_a, 0) + COALESCE(t_r, 0) END AS t_f_raw,
    CASE WHEN w_a IS NOT NULL OR w_r IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(w_a, 0) + COALESCE(w_r, 0) END AS w_f_raw,
    SUM(COALESCE(x_a, 0) + COALESCE(x_r, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY radiologist) AS exams_all_time,
    SUM(w_d) OVER (PARTITION BY month_start) AS rp_w_d,
    SUM(t_d) OVER (PARTITION BY month_start) AS rp_t_d,
    SUM(COALESCE(w_a, 0) + COALESCE(w_r, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY month_start) AS rp_w_f,
    SUM(COALESCE(t_a, 0) + COALESCE(t_r, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY month_start) AS rp_t_f
  FROM monthly
),
tagged AS (
  SELECT *, exams_all_time >= :min_exams AS q FROM pooled
)
SELECT month_start AS `Month`, DATE_FORMAT(month_start, 'yyyy-MM') AS `Month Label`,
  team_rolled_up AS `Provider Practice`, radiologist AS `Radiologist`, exams_all_time AS `Exams All Time`,
  CASE WHEN q THEN x_d END AS x_d, CASE WHEN q THEN t_d END AS t_d, CASE WHEN q THEN w_d END AS w_d,
  CASE WHEN q THEN x_r END AS x_r, CASE WHEN q THEN t_r END AS t_r, CASE WHEN q THEN w_r END AS w_r,
  CASE WHEN q THEN x_f_raw END AS x_f, CASE WHEN q THEN t_f_raw END AS t_f, CASE WHEN q THEN w_f_raw END AS w_f,
  CASE WHEN q AND x_f_raw > 0 THEN radiologist END AS active_rad,
  n_d, n_f, rp_w_d, rp_t_d, rp_w_f, rp_t_f
FROM tagged

    x_f AS x, NULLIF(t_f, 0) AS t, w_f AS w FROM mv WHERE x_f > 0

  UNION ALL

    x_d, NULLIF(t_d, 0), w_d FROM mv WHERE x_d > 0
  UNION ALL

    b.month_start, b.x, b.t, b.w
  FROM baseline b
  CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('Legacy'), ('Both')) AS p(platform)
  CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('Full Mosaic'), ('Reporting Only'), ('Drafting Only'), ('Capture Only')) AS m(mode)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT p.platform, s.mode, s.team_rolled_up, s.radiologist, s.parent_exam, s.managing_practice, s.local_region,
    s.month_start, s.x, s.t, s.w
  FROM mosaic s

)

  parent_exam AS `Parent Exam`, managing_practice AS `Managing Practice`, local_region AS `Local Region`,

FROM tagged

### Definitions & notes
- **Baseline / legacy VR** = each radiologist's own pre-Mosaic efficiency on legacy voice recognition. Efficiency % change = Mosaic efficiency vs. that baseline (TBWU per hour). Implied read-time savings is the same comparison expressed as time per exam (negative = less time per exam).
- **% of RPCE exams** (Reporting / Drafting / Capture) = share of RPCE-sourced exams read in Mosaic, same +0.02 adjustment as the PowerBI report.
- **Drafting** efficiency is restricted to CR/CT exams on both the Mosaic and baseline side (intentional, documented divergence from the PowerBI page).
- **Capacity** = the PowerBI Mosaic Impact Report *Practice Summary* at its defaults: TBWU 26 per shift, shifts with a baseline only, PowerBI's shift-length exclusions, all shifts. Each shift's Mosaic-era output (New Capacity) is compared with its legacy shift baseline and averaged per shift; practices without any TBWU 26 baseline are hidden, as in PowerBI.
- **Utilization** = reading time / shift time per shift, averaged (PowerBI *New Utilization*, TBWU 26/Shift). New Efficiency ignores shifts with efficiency above 1, as PowerBI does.
- Outlier exams are excluded from efficiency (PowerBI default). The current month is partial in trend lines.

### What is holding drafting back
- **Radiologist not enabled** (consent declined, ops declined, or *incomplete process* -- the radiologist drafted under 10% of that model's exams that week) is the largest bucket. *Incomplete process* alone is the single biggest lever: these radiologists have drafting but are not using it consistently.
- **Enabled, draft not used** (radiologist and practice both live, exam opened without a draft) is the workflow / product bucket. *Opened >5 min* means the draft had time to arrive but was not used; *opened <5 min* points to draft latency.
- **Practice not enabled** is small: it only covers CT Chest / CT Spine exams at practices not yet live on those models.
- Use the tables below to find where each bucket concentrates (region, team, model, radiologist).

### Definitions & notes
- **Draftable** = Mosaic exams on drafting-eligible procedure codes. Each exam is classified once, first match wins: Drafted > Rad declined > Ops declined > Incomplete process > Practice not enabled > Never opened > Opened <5 min > Opened >5 min. % = share of all draftable exams (Drafted included), as in PowerBI's *Category % of Draftable*.
- Same source as the PowerBI Volume report's Draftable page (daily snapshot, refreshed 7am CT). Completed Mon-Sun weeks only, so the current week is not shown. XR/MSK and the CT models switch on per radiologist per week; Do-Not-Launch radiologists are excluded.
- **Local Region** here is PowerBI's Draftable mapping, which places a few teams (RP Florida West, RAA, Lakefront Imaging) in a different region than the other pages. **Managing Practice** does not apply to this page.
